race.description: Celestial Legend @ Woodside Park Mdn Plate
race.comment: Looks the perfect race for MENESS (14) who has just found one better in two runs this time in against much stronger opposition. He missed a nose to Zambales fresh at Bendigo then went toe-to-toe with True Rebel at Geelong who is high up in Derby markets. Gets every chance to break through. CORVIGLIA (1) ran well fresh at Caulfield Heath behind an impressive winner who has franked the form. Fitter now and will take holding out. BOHEMIAN BOY (13) tackled the Spring Preview at Caulfield last time and was okay. That form is a little bit suspect but he's a chance. WINDHOWLER (6) was much better second up, he just needs a bit of luck from the gate to be figuring.
